q: How do I calculate a cigarette factory's carbon footprint per thousand sticks?
title: Cigarette factory CO2 per 1,000
short: Divide factory electricity and boiler fuel by thousands of sticks made. Purchased tobacco, filters, paper and board are Scope 3 and usually larger than the factory. Smoke from the product in use is Scope 3 Category 11 for the maker.

ul: Electricity for making and packing machines and humidity control.
Purchases of leaf, filters, paper and packaging.

p: Combustion of the product by smokers releases CO2 and other gases; report it in Category 11 with the method stated.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
